source: Onkelos Leviticus 8:2; Sifra, Tzav, Mekhilta DeMiluim I
claim_en: THE INSTALLATION INTAKE: 'Take Aaron' announces his RE-ACCEPTANCE after the calf (the rejection known from Moses' prayer, Deut 9:20); persons are taken WITH WORDS — the recorded four-verse census of Moses' takings — and Onkelos renders the take-verb as BRING NEAR; and the take-list is audited item by item against its Exodus command verses (garments — Exod 28:4; oil — 30:25; bullock — 29:10; rams — 29:15,19; the basket), the order difference noted in the row: the spec/execution audit at the installation's front door.
middah: plain ('take Aaron' as his re-acceptance after the calf; persons taken with words — the four-verse census of Moses' takings, ink, beside; the received translation of 8:2 the ink leg)

source: Onkelos Leviticus 8:10; Sifra, Tzav, Mekhilta DeMiluim I
claim_en: THE DRESSING PROTOCOL: The section is learned for its time AND the generations — the same procedure serves the daily golden service and the Yom Kippur white; Moses is Aaron's dresser in life and death; the ORDER law: clothed THEN anointed (the descending oil of Ps 133:2), and each vessel anointed individually; R. Yehudah's OIL AUDIT: twelve logs weighed against every recorded consumption — the miracle claimed on the arithmetic itself, the oil preserved whole for the generations; Onkelos renders the anointing throughout as ELEVATION — the oil of greatness.
middah: plain (the dressing protocol for its time and the generations; Moses the dresser; the order law clothed then anointed, M-11, beside; the received translation of 8:10 the ink leg)

claim_en: PARTNERS' HAND-LAYING: Aaron AND his sons laid their hands on one bullock — and partners' offerings are likened to theirs: EVERY partner of a shared offering lays hands; the bullock is named 'of the sin-offering' only at its accounting (Exod 29:14), resolved to Aaron's own.
middah: I3 (Aaron and his sons on one bullock — partners' offerings likened to theirs, every partner lays hands; the bullock named the sin offering's at Exod 29:14)

claim_en: THE BOOTSTRAP OFFICIANT: Moses served in the high-priesthood all seven days — he slaughtered, sprinkled, purified, poured, atoned — the princess-parable making the rule explicit: the INSTALLER OFFICIATES until the installed one is trained. And the altar-atonement's stated object: THAT THERE BE NO THEFT IN THE SANCTUARY — unwilling donations would taint the house — with Isaiah 61:8 cited in the row ('I hate theft even for a burnt-offering'): the prophetic voice matched to the computed entry.
middah: E26 (the princess parable makes the rule explicit — the installer officiates until the installed is trained; the altar's atonement against theft with Isaiah 61:8 cited)

claim_en: THE RECORDED RUN: The burnt-offering ram's execution is matched by the teacher VERSE FOR VERSE against Leviticus 1's procedure — pieces, head, and suet (1:12), innards and legs washed (1:13), the whole ram smoked, the acceptance idiom — the installation narrative as a recorded RUN of the compiled function; everything explicit except FLAYING, with the recorded patch ('some say there is no cutting without flaying'); hand-laying and sprinkling for the olah derived from this execution; even the burnt bullock gives its fats to the altar first.
middah: M-22 (the burnt-offering ram's execution matched verse for verse against Leviticus 1 — the installation narrative as the compiled function's recorded run; flaying the one gap, with the recorded patch)

source: Onkelos Leviticus 8:23; Sifra, Tzav, Mekhilta DeMiluim I
claim_en: THE ATOMIC TRANSACTION: 'The second ram' is re-stated to teach ATOMICITY: bullock without both rams — not sanctified; rams without bullock — not; all three without the basket — not: the investiture is one indivisible transaction. THE THREE BLOODS TABLE: six applications, two, thirteen — each blood's operation list distinct (the bullock's: sprinkling, roundabout, the roof purification, the base pouring); the ear-ridge is the middle wall, the thumb the middle joint (Onkelos rendering the ridge as the ear's HEIGHT); the sprinkling count itself a recorded numeric dispute (six / nine / fifteen); and THE COMMIT POINT: the sanctification of Aaron and his sons is CONSUMMATED ONLY AT THE BLOOD SPR...
middah: E10 ('the second ram' re-stated to teach atomicity — the investiture one indivisible transaction; the three bloods table; the ear-ridge and the thumb; the received translation of 8:23 the ink leg)

source: Onkelos Leviticus 8:33; Sifra, Tzav, Mekhilta DeMiluim I
claim_en: THE COMPUTED CALENDAR: The installation began the TWENTY-THIRD OF ADAR and completed the FIRST OF NISSAN (twenty-three and seven); all seven days Moses SET UP the tabernacle every morning, sacrificed in it, and TOOK IT APART — the eighth-day handling a recorded dispute (R. Yossi b. R. Yehudah: taken apart that morning too, standing from its evening). Cook at the door, eat there; the remainder BURNT (Exod 29:34 matched) — the installation's own leftover clause; and Onkelos DECODES THE IDIOM: 'he shall fill your hands' rendered 'he shall OFFER YOUR OFFERING' — the investiture named by its offerings throughout.
middah: plain (the computed calendar — from the twenty-third of Adar to the first of Nisan; the tabernacle set up and taken apart daily; the received translation of 8:33 the ink leg)

source: Onkelos Leviticus 8:35; Sifra, Tzav, Mekhilta DeMiluim I
claim_en: THE PROTOTYPE TEMPLATE: 'As He has done this day' exports the milluim week for the generations: SEVEN DAYS' SEPARATION for the Yom Kippur high priest (the counselors' cell) and for the red-heifer priest — with the recorded precaution as the reason; the service atones until the resurrection. The vigil: day and night at the door, seven days — and Onkelos renders the charge kept toward THE WORD ('the charge of the Memra of the LORD'); Aaron and his sons DID — in joy, as from the Mouth itself. Alongside: the no-entity-without-a-mitzvah doctrine (fruits, gates, garments, clean and unclean beasts, the hunted, the unnamed classes — every entity class carries a law) and the exchange symmetry (the...
middah: I3 ('as He has done this day' exports the week for the generations — seven days' separation for the Day of Atonement's priest and the red heifer's; the vigil; the no-entity-without-a-commandment doctrine and the exchange symmetry, E27, beside; the received translation of 8:35 the ink leg)
